decisions.notes: CWE-122 present cites an out-of-bounds destination write and wcsncpy but omits the 200-byte allocation that establishes capacity for only 50 wchar_t elements.
CWE-122 not_observed cites the terminator write and wcsncpy but omits the 400-byte allocation that distinguishes the fixed 100-wchar_t destination.
CWE-122 present omits the 0x32-byte allocation; the cited index-99 write is itself beyond that capacity and does not establish the allocation-to-copy relation.
CWE-122 not_observed omits the 100-byte allocation that makes the index-99 terminator and 99-byte copy safe in the paired fixed representation.
CWE-122 present omits the erroneous strlen-on-wide-string assignment that underestimates the source length and makes the derived allocation too small.
CWE-122 not_observed omits the wcslen assignment that correctly derives the allocation size from the wide-string source and distinguishes the fixed relation.
